title: A problem to use at drive thru's
text: I only used the $50 card one time at Burger King. It was difficult to use. Must be run as credit, not as gift card. No remaining balance is given at the end of the transaction. And although it's on me, I misplaced or lost this card after only spending about $6 of it. I was hoping that the seller could provide me with the full card number so that I could at least use it online for other purchases. They failed to respond. I have the receipt from BK, but it only shows the last 4 numbers. There isn't a way of contacting happy cards customer service online that I could figure out. I wish I'd just stuck with credit cards. A lot safer.
